title: Derek, 34
body: Recently single. Jennifer didn't understand my passion. Looking for someone who appreciates a $47 cup of coffee. 847 quantum brewing experiments and counting. I wake up at 3:47 AM to observe my coffee grounds entering superposition. Yes, I time it to the second. Yes, it matters.
summary: Quantum coffee obsessive. Recently single. 847 experiments and counting.

prompts.question: My ideal first date involves...
prompts.answer: A tour of my quantum coffee lab. I'll explain the entanglement process while we wait the precise 3.7 seconds for the brew cycle. No touching the equipment, please.

prompts.question: I'm looking for someone who...
prompts.answer: Understands that 'regular coffee' is just molecular chaos in a cup. Also must be okay with my 847 coffee makers. They each have names.

prompts.question: The way to my heart is...
prompts.answer: Through properly entangled water molecules. And corn. Corn in the coffee? Maybe. I'm experimenting.
